title: rubus lejeunei var. crispus
intro: Rubus lejeunei var. crispus, commonly known as Raspberry leaf or Raspberry vine, is a plant species belonging to the Rosaceae family. This plant is rich in nutrients and has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including relieving menstrual cramps, promoting digestive health, and supporting bone health. The therapeutic actions of Raspberry leaf include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and anti-spasmodic properties, which contribute to its ability to soothe digestive issues and menstrual discomfort. The bioactive constituents of Raspberry leaf include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins, which contribute to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects.
